verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪਾ ਖੋਇ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਗੇਹ ਸਮਤ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh aapaa khoi jeevan mukat gat bisam bidheh geh samat subhaau hai ||

en.bdb: The Sikh follower of Guru loses his self and achieves salvation in his life when still alive. Leading a house holder’s life, he feels no concern for distress or peace/comfort that comes his way.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਸਮ ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਅਰੁ ਪੰੁਨ ਪਾਪ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਚਾਉ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: janam maran sam narak surag ar pa(n)un paap sa(n)pat bipat chi(n)taa chaau hai ||

en.bdb: And then birth and death, sin and piety, heaven and hell, pleasures and tribulations, worry and happiness all means equal to him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਨ ਗ੍ਰਹ ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਲੋਗ ਬੇਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਧੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਸੋਗਾਨੰਦ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਤਾਉ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: ban greh jog bhog log bedh giaan dhiaan dhukh sukh sogaana(n)dh mitr satr taau hai ||

en.bdb: For such a Guru-conscious person, jungle and home, enjoyment and renunciation, folk traditions and traditions of the scriptures, knowledge and contemplation, peace and distress, sorrow and pleasure, friendship and enmity are all the same.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਸਟ ਕਨਿਕ ਬਿਖੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਉਨਮਨ ਅਨੁਰਾਉ ਹੈ ॥੯੦॥
verses.translit_en: losaT kanik bikh a(n)mirat agan jal sahaj samaadh unaman anuraau hai ||90||

en.bdb: A lump of earth or gold, poison and nectar, water and fire are all the same for a Guru-conscious person. Because, his love is to remain absorbed in the stable state of perpetual knowledge of the Guru. (90)
